mentions.name: escape93
mentions.description: A life simulator built around an in-game operating system that includes a working web browser, an MS Paint clone, and other apps. Gameplay is set after Earth has been evacuated, in a gravity-less cubic spaceship where the player delivers pizza and stocks vending machines.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on escape93, a life simulator with an in-game OS. It has a working web browser, an MS Paint clone and more.
Also, earth has been evacuated, up and down no longer exists and your job is to deliver pizza and stock vending machines in a cubic space ship.
mentions.author: yethiel
